items.title: Moderna pops on positive melanoma vaccine trial
items.summary: Moderna (MRNA) shares jumped after the company reported positive results from a late-stage trial of its personalized melanoma vaccine.  Bernstein senior analyst of US Biopharmaceuticals Courtney Breen joins Julie Hyman on Market Catalysts to break down the trial results, what’s driving the stock move, and the potential pricing opportunity for Moderna’s cancer vaccine.
